grid.title: Extrato Bancário Conciliado
grid.expression:
SELECT V.*, -- Bloco do Saldo Inicial mantido, mas com MAX(T1.SALDOBCO) para blindar contra duplicidade na TGFSBC ((SELECT SUM(ACUM) FROM (SELECT T4.VLRLANC * T4.RECDESP AS ACUM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY T4.DHCONCILIACAO) AS numero_linha FROM TGFMBC T4 WHERE T4.CODCTABCOINT = :P_CODCTABCOINT AND T4.CONCILIADO = 'S' AND T4.DHCONCILIACAO >= :P_DHCONCILIACAO.INI AND T4.DHCONCILIACAO <= :P_DHCONCILIACAO.FIN ORDER BY T4.DHCONCILIACAO) subquery WHERE subquery.numero_linha <= to_number(V.LINHAMESTRE, '999999')) + ((SELECT NVL(SUM(T3.VLRLANC * T3.RECDESP),0) FROM TGFMBC T3 WHERE T3.CODCTABCOINT = V.CODCTABCOINT AND T3.CONCILIADO = 'S' AND T3.DHCONCILIACAO >= TRUNC((V.DHCONCILIACAO-1),'MM') AND T3.DHCONCILIACAO < (:P_DHCONCILIACAO.INI)) + (SELECT MAX(T1.SALDOBCO) FROM TGFSBC T1 WHERE T1.CODCTABCOINT = :P_CODCTABCOINT AND T1.REFERENCIA = (SELECT MAX(REFERENCIA) FROM TGFSBC T2 WHERE T2.CODCTABCOINT = T1.CODCTABCOINT AND T2.REFERENCIA <= (V.DHCONCILIACAO-1))))) AS SALDOINICIAL,
-- Colunas trazidas via LEFT JOIN FIN.CODPARC || ' - ' || PAR.NOMEPARC AS PARCEIRO, FIN.CODNAT || ' - ' || NAT.DESCRNAT AS NATUREZA
FROM (SELECT MBC.CODCTABCOINT, CTA.DESCRICAO, CTA.CODCTABCO, (CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = 1 THEN VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) as RECEITA, (CASE WHEN MBC.RECDESP = -1 THEN -VLRLANC ELSE 0 END) AS DESPESA, MBC.HISTORICO, MBC.NUMDOC, MBC.DHCONCILIACAO - 1 AS DTSALDOBCO, MBC.DHCONCILIACAO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MBC.DHCONCILIACAO) AS LINHAMESTRE, MBC.NUBCO FROM TGFMBC MBC INNER JOIN TSICTA CTA ON MBC.CODCTABCOINT = CTA.CODCTABCOINT WHERE MBC.CODCTABCOINT = :P_CODCTABCOINT AND MBC.DHCONCILIACAO >= :P_DHCONCILIACAO.INI AND MBC.DHCONCILIACAO <= :P_DHCONCILIACAO.FIN ) V -- Substituímos os Selects aninhados por LEFT JOINs limpos na consulta principal LEFT JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON V.NUBCO = FIN.NUBCO AND V.NUBCO IS NOT NULL AND V.NUBCO > 0 LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT ORDER BY V.DHCONCILIACAO
